long_biography.plain_text:
At Belpasso in Sicily, Donato Ammaturo’s Ludoil group converted a composting site into a source of renewable gas. The plant uses organic household and garden waste to produce biomethane for the national gas grid, with the remaining material processed into agricultural compost. Commercial gas deliveries began in 2025.

As publisher of L’Espresso, Ammaturo has also backed a broader digital offering around the printed magazine. Its renewal plans brought together an updated website and app, podcasts and public events. An associated archive project was designed to make decades of the weekly’s articles accessible online.

confidence.reason: The annual report establishes the completed plant conversion and first grid delivery. The magazine's own programme names its publisher and intended digital offerings; the archive is expressly described as a project, not a completed launch.
